Healthcare – Dental and Vision
Direct Deposit
 
Job Description: 
Temp-to-Hire | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Job Description: Medical Assistant – OB/GYN
Prestigious, High-End OB/GYN Medical Practice
Position Overview
We are seeking a professional, compassionate, and detail-oriented Medical Assistant with OB/GYN experience to join a prestigious, high-end obstetrics and gynecology practice. The ideal candidate will provide exceptional patient care, maintain a polished and professional demeanor, and deliver outstanding service in a patient-focused clinical environment.
This position is ideal for a motivated Medical Assistant who understands women's healthcare, values patient confidentiality, and can work efficiently in a fast-paced medical office while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and patient satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
  • Assist physicians with patient examinations, gynecological procedures, and routine clinical activities.
  • Prepare examination rooms and ensure instruments and equipment are clean, organized, and ready for patient visits.
  • Obtain and document vital signs, medical histories, medications, and patient information.
  • Support OB/GYN patient visits, including annual examinations, prenatal visits, and follow-up appointments.
  • Assist with specimen collection, laboratory testing, and preparation of laboratory requisitions as directed.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and update information in the electronic health record (EHR) system.
  • Schedule appointments, coordinate patient follow-ups, and assist with referrals and medical records.
  • Provide patients with professional, compassionate, and discreet service.
  • Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and protect patient confidentiality.
  • Support front-office and back-office operations as needed.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming clinical environment consistent with a high-end medical practice.
Required Qualifications
  • Medical Assistant diploma or certificate from an accredited or recognized training program.
  • Minimum of 1–2 years of Medical Assistant experience, preferably in an OB/GYN practice.
  • Previous experience assisting with women's healthcare and gynecological examinations.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology, clinical procedures, and patient care protocols.
  • Experience with electronic health records and medical documentation.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.
  • Professional appearance, excellent interpersonal skills, and a patient-centered approach.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, fast-paced clinical environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience in a high-end or boutique OB/GYN practice.
  • Experience assisting with prenatal care, annual gynecological examinations, and women's health procedures.
  • Phlebotomy, EKG, and specimen collection skills.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Experience with appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and referral coordination.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The successful candidate will be polished, dependable, compassionate, and highly organized. They will understand the importance of creating a comfortable and professional experience for patients while supporting physicians and clinical staff with efficient, accurate, and confidential care.
Position Type: Full-time
Experience Level: Minimum 1–2 years
Education: Medical Assistant diploma or certificate required

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Quality Manager to work at a company located in the Hollywood, FL area!

Job Title: Quality Manager
 
Job Location: Hollywood, FL
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $95,000
 
SUMMARY: The Quality Manager is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and execution of Quality operations within an aerospace metal additive manufacturing (AM) environment. Reporting to the Director of Quality, this role manages Quality Engineering, inspection, and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities and personnel, supports the Quality Management System (QMS), drives product and process compliance, and leads corrective action, audit readiness, and continuous improvement activities. The Quality Manager works closely with the Materials Lab, Mechanical Testing, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and customers to ensure products meet AS9100, NADCAP, customer, and internal requirements.
 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
•           Manages the day-to-day activities of the Quality department, including Quality Engineering, inspection, and NDT personnel, to ensure products meet quality, integrity, functionality, drawing, specification, and customer requirements
•           Supports the Director of Quality in implementing department priorities, staffing plans, quality standards, and cross-functional initiatives; provides routine status, risk, and performance updates and escalates significant quality issues in a timely manner
•           Supports the maintenance and continuous improvement of the site QMS with hands-on, working-level compliance to AS9100 and customer requirements; ensures assigned procedures, work instructions, records, and quality documentation remain accurate, current, and audit ready
•           Analyzes customer, regulatory, drawing, specification, and contractual quality requirements and ensures applicable requirements are incorporated into internal procedures, inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and production processes
•           Aligns process and inspection documentation with demonstrated process capabilities, ensuring work instructions, inspection methods, control plans, and acceptance criteria accurately reflect how the process is performed and controlled
•           Plans, prepares for, and actively participates in AS9100, NADCAP, customer, internal, and regulatory audits, including NDT-related NADCAP audits; coordinates evidence collection, supports auditor requests, leads or assists RCCA responses, and drives assigned findings and corrective actions to timely closure
•           Manages day-to-day NDT operations and personnel, ensuring NDT methods, procedures, approved practices, records, and inspection activities meet customer, NADCAP, regulatory, and internal requirements; ensures NDT personnel qualification and certification requirements are maintained and coordinates with the Director of Quality and responsible Level 3 personnel as required
•           Provides technical leadership and support for Quality Engineering, inspection, and NDT activities, including interpretation of drawings, specifications, GD&T, inspection planning, measurement methods, NDT requirements, and acceptance criteria; develops or reviews detailed inspection instructions as needed
•           Leads or supports Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities for new products and processes, including participation in design reviews and development and maintenance of PFMEAs, Control Plans, inspection plans, and related quality planning documentation
•           Conducts and/or oversees inspections and quality control checks; reviews inspection and test results, supports disposition recommendations, and ensures appropriate use of CMM, 3D scanning, and other measuring equipment for layout inspection and verification
•           Coordinates the selection, qualification, calibration, and availability of product acceptance equipment, testers, gages, fixtures, and measurement systems needed to support inspection and product acceptance activities
•           Programs and/or oversees programming and operation of CMM, 3D scanning, and other measurement equipment; supports layout inspection, GD&T verification, and generation of inspection reports and data packages including FAIR/AS9102, PPAP, ADP, and customer-required formats
•           Develops, monitors, and reports quality metrics, levels, and trends; evaluates statistical data, recurring defects, escapes, rework, scrap, audit performance, and corrective action effectiveness to identify opportunities for improvement
•           Organizes, analyzes, and presents quality, inspection, audit, defect, and process-performance data to management to support risk assessment, prioritization, and decision making
•           Leads investigation of product and process discrepancies and drives root cause and corrective/preventive action using structured problem-solving methods; supports capability studies, quality audits, process improvement activities, and other engineering evaluations utilizing Six Sigma methodology where appropriate
•           Interacts with customers, suppliers, Engineering, Operations, and other functions to resolve design, development, production, inspection, and acceptance issues; supports customer inquiries, complaints, and quality concerns and ensures actions are implemented to prevent recurrence
•           Supervises, coaches, and develops Quality Engineering, inspection, and NDT personnel; establishes expectations, provides feedback, supports training in quality tools, inspection methods, and applicable NDT requirements, promotes accountability and continuous improvement, and assists with other tasks as required
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
•           Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in a technical or related field required
•           Progressive quality experience in a manufacturing environment, including experience leading or supervising Quality Engineering, inspection, NDT, or related quality functions
•           Hands-on working knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including day-to-day execution and maintenance of QMS processes and documentation
•           Demonstrated experience actively participating in AS9100, NADCAP, customer, and/or internal audits, including preparation of objective evidence and corrective action follow-up; experience with NDT-related NADCAP requirements strongly preferred
•           Experience implementing and maintaining NADCAP-accredited inspection processes and supporting compliance to applicable NDT and/or inspection requirements

job.title: NDT Technician Level II
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a NDT Technician Level II to work at a company located in the Hollywood, FL area!

Job Title: NDT Technician Level II
 
Job Location: Hollywood, FL
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $85-95K
 
Job Description:          
 
We are seeking a career-minded individual for the position of NDT Technician Level II, specializing in Computed Radiography (CR) and Digital Radiography (DR), preferably someone who is looking for long-term growth and potential.  In addition to the job description below, candidates must possess strong customer service skills, an eye for detail, and the ability to multi-task at a quick pace.  Being a team player is a must!
 
SUMMARY: Perform and interpret Computed Radiography (CR) and Digital Radiography (DR) inspections on flight-critical additively manufactured components to identify internal flaws that could affect part integrity. As a Level II technician, independently set up, calibrate, and conduct radiographic examinations, interpret and evaluate results against applicable codes, standards, and specifications, and accept or reject parts per written procedures. The testing processes do not damage the structure or object being tested. Technicians look for porosity, inclusions, cracks, and other discontinuities which might lead to failure of the components.
 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
•           Set up, perform, and interpret Computed Radiography (CR) and Digital Radiography (DR) examinations in accordance with customer, industry, and manufacturer's specifications
•           Ensure that all CR/DR imaging equipment, digital detector arrays, phosphor plates, and associated systems are in proper working order, current calibration, and system qualification at all times
•           Perform CR/DR radiographic inspection of components and materials processed, including image acquisition, enhancement, and digital archiving
•           Interpret and evaluate CR/DR images against applicable acceptance criteria; ensure proper documentation of discrepancies and disposition on appropriate forms, work orders, tags, or logs
•           Ensures that shift turnover procedures are followed and properly documented
•           Complies with procedures and company policies
•           Evaluate image quality indicators (IQIs) and density/contrast levels to confirm CR/DR image compliance prior to interpretation
•           Provide guidance and oversight to NDT Level I technicians performing CR/DR examinations
•           Write, review, and approve CR/DR technique sheets and part-specific procedures in accordance with applicable specifications
•           Assist in other tasks as required
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
•           High school diploma or equivalent; college or trade school preferred
•           NDT Level II certification in Radiographic Testing (RT), with documented experience in Computed Radiography (CR) and Digital Radiography (DR), required in accordance with NAS 410 / SNT-TC-1A
•           Three or more years of aerospace manufacturing experience required
•           Current annual near-vision and color-perception (Jaeger J1/J2) eye examination required, per applicable specification
•           Must be a highly motivated self-starter that can identify potential problems and collaborate with management to take action
•           Must possess willingness to assist where needed to ensure the company meets its goals and objectives on time 
•           Must possess time management skills
•           Willing to learn and apply new skills
•           Good written and oral communication skills
•           Ability to balance multiple tasks simultaneously and effectively
•           Demonstrated ability to work well with cross-functional groups
•           Self-motivated, able to multi-task, and detail oriented
•           Strong organizational, problem-solving and decision-making skills
Background checks and Drug Screenings will be completed on all candidates considered for hire. 
 
REQUIREMENTS:
•           High school diploma from an accredited institution
•           Familiar with Microsoft Word and Excel, and proficient with CR/DR digital imaging and image-review software
•           Must be able to learn procedures quickly and be a team player
•           Easily adapt to new organizations / technical environments
•           Working knowledge of radiation safety practices, dosimetry, and applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., state/NRC licensing)
•           Must be able to perform a variety of routine tasks and demonstrate a good working knowledge of equipment, procedures and working with common hand tools
 
PREFERRED:
•           Experience with additive manufacturing (powder bed fusion) components preferred
•           Additional NDT Level II certification in Penetrant Testing (PT) or Ultrasonic Testing (UT) preferred
 
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIORNMENT:
•           Frequently required to sit, walk, or stand
•           Continually utilize visual acuity to operate equipment, read technical information, and/or use a keyboard
•           Frequently required to lift/push/carry items up to 50 pounds 
•           Work on Specialized equipment

Excavator / Front Loader Operator – Operador de Excavadora y Cargador Frontal

 Pay: $24.00 per hour + $36.00 per hour overtime

 Language: English or Spanish accepted
Job Description / Descripción del puesto
We are looking for an experienced and dependable Excavator / Front Loader Operator to join our team in Miami, Florida. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience operating heavy equipment, working safely on construction sites, and assisting with daily site operations.
Buscamos un Operador de Excavadora y Cargador Frontal con experiencia, responsable y comprometido para unirse a nuestro equipo en Miami, Florida. El candidato ideal debe tener experiencia operando maquinaria pesada, trabajar de manera segura en obras de construcción y apoyar las operaciones diarias del proyecto.

Responsibilities / Responsabilidades
  • Operate excavators and front loaders safely and efficiently.
  • Operate heavy equipment for digging, loading, moving, and handling materials.
  • Load and unload dirt, gravel, debris, and other construction materials.
  • Perform daily equipment inspections and report mechanical issues.
  • Follow all job-site safety rules and company procedures.
  • Maintain equipment cleanliness and report maintenance needs.
  • Work closely with supervisors and other crew members to complete daily tasks.
  • Operar excavadoras y cargadores frontales de manera segura y eficiente.
  • Realizar trabajos de excavación, carga, movimiento y manejo de materiales.
  • Cargar y mover tierra, grava, escombros y otros materiales de construcción.
  • Inspeccionar la maquinaria diariamente y reportar problemas mecánicos.
  • Cumplir con las normas de seguridad y los procedimientos de la empresa.
  • Mantener el equipo en buenas condiciones y colaborar con el resto del equipo.

Requirements / Requisitos
  • Previous experience operating excavators and/or front loaders.
  • Ability to operate heavy equipment safely and responsibly.
  • Knowledge of construction-site safety procedures.
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work as part of a team.
  • Ability to communicate in English or Spanish.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Se requiere experiencia previa operando excavadoras y/o cargadores frontales.
  • Capacidad para operar maquinaria pesada de forma segura y responsable.
  • Conocimiento de las normas de seguridad en obras.
  • Puntualidad, responsabilidad y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
  • Puede comunicarse en español o inglés.
  • Debe estar autorizado legalmente para trabajar en los Estados Unidos.
Pay and Schedule / Pago y horario
  • Regular pay / Pago regular: $24.00 per hour.
  • Overtime pay / Pago de horas extra: $36.00 per hour for qualifying overtime hours, in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  • Monday–Friday / Lunes a viernes: 7:00 AM–6:00 PM.
  • Saturday / Sábado: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM.
  • Location / Ubicación: Miami, FL 33142.
Regular hours and overtime will be calculated according to applicable labor laws and actual hours worked.
Las horas regulares y las horas extra se calcularán conforme a las leyes laborales aplicables y las horas efectivamente trabajadas.

job.title: In-Process Inspector
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Aviation In-Process and Final Inspectors   to work at a company located in the Opa Locka, FL area!

Job Title: Aviation In-Process and Final Inspectors  
 
Job Location: Opa Locka, FL
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $25/hr, 1st shift
 
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to inspect aircraft components, mechanical assemblies, and parts throughout repair, overhaul, and assembly operations. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of quality inspection experience, preferably in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or mechanical repair.
Candidates must be able to read technical documentation, identify defects, use precision measuring tools, and maintain accurate inspection records while ensuring compliance with quality standards and applicable FAA requirements.
 
Responsibilities
  • Perform in-process inspections of aircraft components, mechanical assemblies, and parts.
  • Verify workmanship against technical drawings, specifications, work instructions, and approved technical data.
  • Identify defects, damage, dimensional discrepancies, and improper assembly.
  • Use precision measuring instruments, including calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Review work orders and inspection records to ensure all required steps are completed.
  • Verify part numbers, serial numbers, and component traceability documentation.
  • Document inspection results and report nonconforming materials or workmanship.
  • Work with technicians, mechanics, and quality personnel to resolve discrepancies.
  • Verify corrective actions are completed before components move to the next stage of production or repair.
  • Follow company quality procedures, safety standards, and applicable FAA requirements.
Qualifications
  • 2–3 years of experience in quality inspection, mechanical inspection, or a related field.
  • Aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or mechanical assembly experience preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions.
  • Experience using precision measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Basic computer skills for maintaining inspection records.
  • Good communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • High school diploma or GED required.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience inspecting aircraft components, landing gear, hydraulic components, or mechanical assemblies.
  • Familiarity with FAA repair station procedures and aviation quality systems.
  • Knowledge of nonconformance reporting, corrective actions, and component traceability.
  • Experience interpreting dimensional tolerances.

job.title: Millwright
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Millwright  to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: Millwright 
 
Job Location: Coral Gables, FL 33146
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $65K per year
 
Job Description:
The Millwright is responsible for the maintenance, repair, and installation of machinery and equipment across the plant, ensuring the seamless operation of our manufacturing processes. This role supports production, engineering, and quality teams by minimizing equipment downtime and maintaining equipment to FAA, ISO, and customer standards, contributing directly to the quality and efficiency of our products.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
  1. Perform regular maintenance, inspections, and troubleshooting on machinery and equipment to identify and resolve mechanical issues promptly while minimizing production downtime.
  2. Diagnose and repair defective parts with minimal interruption to production.
  3. Calibrate and test machinery and equipment to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  4. Participate in the installation, assembly, and setup of machinery and equipment according to specifications and blueprints to ensure proper functionality and alignment with production requirements.
  5. Maintain plant equipment, including but not limited to:
    • Specialized machines in Machine Shop I and II (mills, lathes, etc.)
    • Lasers (in various departments)
    • Chambers and vibration systems in the Environmental Room
    • Conformal coating ovens and UV curing ovens
    • Pick and place systems
    • Solder systems (including wave solder machine)
    • Injection molding machines
    • Auto insertion machines
    • Pneumatic cable machines
    • SMT wash stations
    • RO water system
    • Nitrogen generator system
    • Paint shop ovens
    • ESD maintenance equipment (including bench and floor equipment)
    • Air generator system
  6. Procure and maintain miscellaneous parts and accessories, such as magazines, tools, black boxes, stencils, microscopes, solder stations, UPS units, and respirator cartridges.
  7. Research alternative parts to expedite repairs.
  8. Train staff on the proper use of equipment and machinery to ensure operational efficiency and compliance with established processes and procedures.
  9. Create and document preventive maintenance and troubleshooting processes.
  10. Adhere to safety procedures and protocols when performing maintenance and repair tasks.
  11. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, and equipment performance in accordance with FAA and ISO 9000 standards, as well as Boeing and other customer requirements.
  12. Generate reports on maintenance schedules, equipment status, and issues encountered for documentation and analysis.
  13. Act as technical liaison with vendors, and source and order parts required for the maintenance or repair of plant equipment.
Required Qualifications
  1. Associate of Science (A.S.) degree in electronics, or equivalent military or technical trade experience.
  2. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a millwright or equipment technician in a manufacturing environment; avionics industry experience is a plus.
Job Skills Required
  1. Solid understanding of mechanical systems, including hydraulics and pneumatics, as well as electrical systems.
  2. Ability to quickly learn new and continuously changing technologies with minimal training.
  3. Proficient in reading and interpreting drawings, schematics, and technical manuals.
  4. Able to use a variety of software to maintain, repair, and program equipment.
  5. Able to identify and mitigate potential safety hazards related to millwright tasks to ensure a safe working environment.
  6. Strong organizational skills and the ability to support multiple projects while balancing priorities and schedules.
  7. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers, production personnel, and management, to optimize equipment performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement manufacturing process improvements.
  8. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
Work Environment
Work is performed primarily on the manufacturing floor and in machine shop areas, with occasional work in outdoor and other environmental conditions. The role involves regular exposure to operating machinery, moderate to high noise levels, and materials such as solder, coatings, and cleaning agents, with appropriate personal protective equipment provided. Flexibility to work occasional overtime, weekends, or off-hours is required to support production schedules and maintenance activities.

Physical Requirements
  • Heavy Work: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Standing for most of the workday while performing essential functions.
  • Ability to climb, bend, stoop, kneel, twist, and reach as required to install, maintain, and repair machinery and equipment.
  • Manual dexterity to handle tools, parts, and equipment, including power and precision tools.
  • Visual acuity to read drawings and schematics, inspect parts, and ensure the accuracy and quality of work performed.

job.description:

Job Title: Shipping Clerk
 
Job Location: Springdale, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18+ per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
 
Position Summary

 The Shipping Clerk is responsible for preparing and maintaining all shipping documentation for domestic and international customer orders. This role coordinates with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, customer service, and warehouse personnel to ensure shipments are properly documented, compliant with applicable regulations, and processed accurately and on time.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Prepare and process all domestic and international shipping documentation.
  • Generate bills of lading, packing lists, commercial invoices, certificates of origin, shipper's letters of instruction (SLI), and other export documents as required.
  • Create shipping paperwork and labels for customer orders using ERP and carrier systems.
  • Ensure export documentation complies with customs, regulatory, and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and transportation providers regarding shipment documentation and export procedures.
  • Review orders for accuracy and verify shipping information, customer requirements, and routing instructions.
  • Maintain shipping records and documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Track shipments and provide shipment status updates to internal stakeholders and customers as needed.
  • Resolve documentation discrepancies, shipping issues, and customs-related inquiries.
  • Assist with maintaining Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) codes, country of origin information, and other trade compliance data.
  • Support audits and compliance reviews related to domestic and international shipping activities.
  • Collaborate with customer service, warehouse, manufacturing, and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfillment.
 
Qualifications
 
  • High school diploma or GED required; associate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of shipping, logistics, export documentation, or customer service experience preferred.
  • Experience preparing international shipping and export documentation.
  • Knowledge of international shipping procedures, customs documentation, Incoterms®, and freight transportation methods.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, shipping software, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
 
Preferred Qualifications
 
  • Experience working with freight forwarders and customs brokers.
  • Knowledge of export compliance regulations and international trade documentation.
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with HTS classifications, AES filings, and letters of credit.
 
Key Performance Indicators
 
  • Shipping documentation accuracy
  • On-time document completion
  • Customs documentation compliance
  • Export documentation error rate
  • Customer service responsiveness
  • Recordkeeping and audit compliance

Duties and responsibilities for this role include but are not limited to financial oversight, sales and Business development, customer relationship management, operational management, health and safety, certification, and compliance management. A more detailed overview is listed below.
 
Profit & Loss (P&L) Management:

job.title: Double Pallet Jack Operator
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Double Pallet Jack Operator to work at a company located in the Lowell, AR area!

Job Title: Double Pallet Jack Operator
 
Job Location: Lowell, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18-$20 per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary

 The Double Pallet Jack Operator safely operates an electric end-rider double pallet jack to transport, stage, load, and unload palletized products throughout a temperature-controlled food distribution center. Working primarily in cooler and freezer environments ranging from 34 degrees F to -10 degrees F, this role requires rapid, high-accuracy order selection and material movement while adhering strictly to OSHA regulations and food safety standards.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
  • Equipment Operation: Safely operate a motorized electric double pallet jack to transport product loads efficiently across dock and freezer floors.
  • Receiving & Staging: Unload inbound shipments, verify load stability, and transport incoming goods to specified cold storage locations or staging lanes.
  • Order Selection & Loading: Accurately pick full-pallet quantities using automated systems (RF scanners or Voice-to-Pick), ensuring proper weight distribution before loading outbound trailers.
  • Pre-Shift Inspections: Perform mandatory daily pre-operation safety checks on assigned equipment (brakes, steering, controls, battery status) and document findings per regulatory standards.
  • Cold-Chain Integrity: Execute tasks efficiently to ensure product exposure to ambient temperatures is minimized, strictly preserving the cold chain.
  • Chemical & Safety: Maintain a clean work environment by removing shrink wrap, damaged pallets, and debris from walkways. Comply with all standard warehouse safety guidelines and immediately report any product damages or equipment malfunctions.
 
Required Qualifications & Competencies
 
  • Experience: Minimum of 1 year of experience operating a powered industrial truck, specifically a motorized electric rider pallet jack, in a fast-paced environment.
  • Licensing & Certification: Must possess or be able to successfully pass the employer-administered OSHA Class III Powered Industrial Truck Certification within the first week of employment.
  • Technical Skills: Experience using warehouse management systems (WMS) and RF scanning barcode devices.
  • Mathematical Competency: Ability to read numbers, perform basic addition and subtraction, and visually confirm accuracy on inventory pick sheets.
 
Physical Demands & Work Environment
 
  • Temperature Extremes: Constant exposure to sub-freezing temperatures (34 degrees F down to -10 degrees F). Proper thermal personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided.
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to stand and ride on the equipment platform for extended periods throughout an 8- to 10-hour shift.
  • Heavy Lifting: Ability to frequently lift, push, pull, or carry objects weighting up to 60 lbs without assistance to restack or secure shifted loads.
  • Agility: Frequent bending, crouching, reaching, and twisting while managing loads and navigating tight warehouse aisles.

job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Maintenance Technician/Mechanic  to work at a company located in the Miramar, FL area!

Job Title: Maintenance Technician/Mechanic 
 
Job Location: Miramar
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $24 - $26 p/hr
 
Técnico de Mantenimiento / Mecánico Industrial
 Horario: lunes a viernes (6:00AM a 2:30PM)
 Pago: $24 - $26 según experiencia.
 
Resumen del puesto
Estamos buscando un Técnico de Mantenimiento / Mecánico Industrial con experiencia para realizar mantenimiento preventivo, diagnosticar fallas, reparar maquinaria y ajustar equipos en un entorno de manufactura y empaque farmacéutico.
El candidato ideal debe tener experiencia práctica en sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos y neumáticos, así como conocimientos de soldadura, aire acondicionado (HVAC), compresores y sistemas PLC. Esta posición es fundamental para garantizar el buen funcionamiento de los equipos, reducir los tiempos de inactividad y mantener un ambiente de trabajo seguro y eficiente.
 
Responsabilidades principales
  • Realizar inspecciones, diagnosticar problemas y ejecutar reparaciones y mantenimiento general en la planta.
  • Investigar especificaciones técnicas e información de los equipos para determinar los procedimientos de reparación adecuados.
  • Diagnosticar fallas mecánicas y realizar reparaciones y ajustes en maquinaria de producción.
  • Lubricar y dar mantenimiento a los equipos de la planta para garantizar su funcionamiento óptimo.
  • Realizar pruebas de funcionamiento después de las reparaciones para verificar que los equipos operen correctamente.
  • Identificar y seleccionar materiales y piezas de reemplazo según los requerimientos mecánicos.
  • Ajustar y calibrar componentes de las máquinas.
  • Instalar, ensamblar y probar maquinaria y equipos nuevos.
  • Inspeccionar visualmente los equipos para identificar desgaste, daños, fallas o posibles averías.
  • Realizar reparaciones de sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos y neumáticos, así como trabajos de soldadura y mantenimiento de sistemas HVAC y compresores.
  • Aplicar conocimientos de PLC (controladores lógicos programables) para diagnosticar problemas y realizar mantenimiento de equipos.
  • Cumplir con las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP), los procedimientos de seguridad, las normas de higiene y los requisitos de limpieza y organización.
  • Mantener las áreas de trabajo limpias, seguras y organizadas.
 
Requisitos mínimos
  • Diploma de escuela secundaria (High School Diploma) o título técnico de, al menos dos años.
  • Mínimo de 5 años de experiencia en mantenimiento dentro de entornos de manufactura y empaque farmacéutico.
  • Experiencia práctica y capacitación en reparación de equipos eléctricos, mecánicos y neumáticos, así como soldadura, aire acondicionado (HVAC) y compresores.
  • Conocimientos prácticos de sistemas PLC.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar turnos nocturnos y fines de semana.
  • Capacidad para trabajar eficazmente con personas de diferentes orígenes y equipos de trabajo diversos.
  • Se prefiere dominio del inglés y español.
 
Ambiente y horario de trabajo
  • Trabajo presencial en una planta de manufactura y empaque.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar noches y fines de semana, según las necesidades de producción.
  • Posición práctica que requiere inspeccionar, diagnosticar, reparar y dar mantenimiento a maquinaria industrial.
 
 
Perfil del candidato ideal
Buscamos una persona responsable, proactiva y con sólidos conocimientos técnicos en mantenimiento industrial, capaz de identificar y resolver problemas mecánicos y eléctricos, mantener los equipos en óptimas condiciones y cumplir con los estándares de seguridad y calidad de la industria farmacéutica.

Employees support the processing, inspection, and packaging of poultry products. Duties vary by department and may include:

Hygiene standards must be upheld.

job.title: Wastewater Treatment Technician
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Wastewater Treatment Technician to work at a company located in the Fort Wayne, IN area!

Job Title:    Wastewater Treatment Technician
 
Job Location:  Fort Wayne
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $19-$26 p/hr DOE 6am-4pm or 4pm-2am Mon-Thur.
 
Job Description:          
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Wastewater Treatment
•           Operate and monitor wastewater treatment equipment (clarifiers, filter presses, ion exchange, reverse osmosis, chemical feed systems, etc.)
•           Perform chemical treatment processes such as pH neutralization, metals precipitation, and chelation breaking for plating/finishing rinse waters
•           Collect and test water samples for pH, metals concentration (e.g., chromium, nickel, copper, zinc, cadmium), and other regulated parameters
•           Maintain accurate logs of chemical usage, flow rates, and lab results for regulatory compliance (EPA, local POTW permits)
•           Perform preventive maintenance and minor repairs on pumps, valves, tanks, and dosing systems
•           Manage handling, storage, and proper disposal of hazardous waste sludge (filter cake) in accordance with RCRA requirements
•           Order and manage inventory of treatment chemicals
•           Troubleshoot process upsets and adjust treatment parameters as needed
 
RoHS Compliance Support
•           Monitor use of RoHS-restricted substances in plating baths and processes, including lead, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, mercury, and certain brominated flame retardants/phthalates where applicable
•           Track substitution of restricted materials with RoHS-compliant alternatives (e.g., trivalent chromium in place of hexavalent chromium plating solutions)
•           Maintain documentation and traceability records supporting customer RoHS compliance declarations and Certificates of Conformance
•           Coordinate with quality/engineering teams on material composition testing (e.g., XRF screening) to verify plated parts meet RoHS threshold limits
•           Assist in maintaining Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and chemical inventory records reflecting RoHS status of process chemicals
•           Support internal and customer audits related to RoHS and REACH compliance
•           Stay current on updates to RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU and amendments) and related restricted substance regulations
 
 
General Compliance & Safety
•           Assist in preparing reports for regulatory agencies (e.g., discharge monitoring reports)
•           Follow all safety protocols when handling acids, caustics, and heavy metal-bearing solutions (PPE, spill response, SDS compliance)
•           Support broader environmental compliance initiatives (RCRA, REACH, Prop 65 as applicable)
•           Must be able to operate a forklift safely 
 
 
Qualifications
•           High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in environmental science, chemistry, or related field preferred
•           1–3+ years of experience in industrial wastewater treatment, plating operations, or a related field preferred
•           Working knowledge of pretreatment regulations and metal finishing discharge limits
•           Familiarity with RoHS/REACH restricted substance requirements strongly preferred
•           Basic chemistry skills and ability to perform lab titrations/tests
•           Mechanical aptitude for pump/valve maintenance
•           Ability to lift 50 lbs, work around chemicals, and wear required PPE
•           Wastewater certification (state-specific) a plus
 
 
Work Environment
•           Industrial plant setting with exposure to chemicals, fumes, and wet/humid conditions
•           May require rotating shifts, weekend, or on-call availability

job.title: Food Safety & Quality Manager
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Food Safety & Quality Manager  to work at a company located in the Doral, FL area!

Job Title: Food Safety & Quality Manager 
Job Location:   Doral 
Pay and Hours Temp to Hire   Salary Range / Rate: $85K – $105K 
 
Position Summary
The Food Safety & Quality Manager will be responsible for overseeing and maintaining all food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance programs within the salmon processing facility. This position will ensure that products are manufactured, handled, stored, and shipped in accordance with company standards, customer specifications, FDA/USDA requirements, HACCP guidelines, and applicable seafood industry regulations.
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, hands-on experience in food manufacturing or seafood processing, and a solid understanding of HACCP, GMPs, sanitation, quality systems, and regulatory compliance.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage and oversee the plant’s Food Safety and Quality Assurance programs.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain HACCP plans and prerequisite programs.
  • Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor production processes to ensure food safety and product quality standards are consistently met.
  • Conduct regular inspections of production areas, equipment, products, and processes.
  • Oversee environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, allergen control, and microbiological testing programs.
  • Review and maintain food safety and quality documentation, records, and reports.
  • Investigate product quality issues, customer complaints, non-conformances, and food safety incidents.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Work closely with Production, Sanitation, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Operations teams to identify and resolve quality and food safety concerns.
  • Establish and monitor quality specifications for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished products.
  • Verify temperature controls throughout receiving, processing, storage, and shipping.
  • Ensure proper handling and storage of salmon and other seafood products to maintain product integrity and food safety.
  • Conduct internal audits and coordinate customer, third-party, and regulatory audits.
  • Maintain relationships and communication with regulatory agencies, customers, laboratories, and third-party auditors as needed.
  • Train and coach employees on GMPs, HACCP, food safety, sanitation, personal hygiene, and quality procedures.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations, seafood industry standards, and customer requirements.
  • Review production and quality data to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure timely completion and accuracy of all food safety and quality records.
  • Participate in product traceability, mock recalls, and recall procedures when necessary.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to food safety, quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
 
Required Qualifications
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related field preferred.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in food manufacturing, seafood processing, or a related industry.
  • Previous management or supervisory experience in a food safety or quality role.
 
Preferred Qualifications
 
  • Seafood or salmon processing experience.
  • SQF, BAP, ASC and other GFSI certification experience.
  • Experience with environmental monitoring programs.
  • Experience with microbiological testing and laboratory coordination.
  • Experience managing customer specifications and audits.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
 
Physical & Work Environment
 
  • Work is performed in a refrigerated seafood processing environment.
  • Ability to work around wet floors, cold temperatures, machinery, noise, and seafood processing equipment.
  • Ability to walk and stand for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to wear required PPE and follow all plant safety and food safety requirements.
  • Must be comfortable working on the production floor and interacting directly with production employees and supervisors.
 
Key Skills
 
  • Food Safety & Quality Assurance
  • HACCP & GMP
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Seafood Processing
  • Quality Control
  • Auditing
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA)
  • Sanitation & Environmental Monitoring
  • Team Leadership
 
Salary Range / Rate: $85K – $105K
• 401(k) + Health Insurance
• 15 Days of Vacation
• 4 Paid Holidays
• Full-Time — must be available to work 1 Saturday per month
Additional Information
  • Target Start Date: ASAP
  • Required vs. Preferred Certifications:
     HACCP is required.
     BAP/ASC certification is preferred.
  • Required English and Spanish Level: Spanish required / Advanced English (must be able to lead an audit)

About the Role

Join our client's maintenance team in a clean, climate-controlled manufacturing facility. Their facility operation features modern, standardized equipment, with much of their machinery less than five years old, helping streamline troubleshooting and maintenance activities. They utilize a fully digital CMMS to support efficient maintenance planning, minimize downtime, and maintain high operational standards. 
 
The Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of machinery and mechanical equipment in the production facility. This role focuses on minimizing downtime, maintaining quality standards, and supporting the production team by performing timely repairs, adjustments, and preventive maintenance.

  • Perform setup, repair, and maintenance of production machinery, including ovens, packing lines, and conveyors, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.

job.title: Controls Technician - 1st Shift
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Controls Maintenance Technician- 1st Shift  to work at a company located in the Des Plains, IL area!

Job Title: Controls Technician- 1st Shift 
 
Job Location: Des Plaines, IL 60018
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:   
 
Pay: $46.00 - $57.50 per hour depending on experience 
 
 
Company Benefits: 
 
• health/dental/vision insurance
• flex spending accounts
• short & long-term disability
• paid holidays and vacation
• bonus opportunities (referral, production, etc.).
 
 
Job Description:       
 
Food manufacturing company in Des Plaines, IL is looking for a 1st Shift Controls Maint. Technician. 
 
Summary of role:
This position will be responsible for development, testing and implementation of all programming and electrical controls. This would include all programmable controller platforms, graphical user interface platforms, gateways, AC/DC electrical schematic development and debugging as well as training personnel on these systems both operationally and technically. This position is key to the company as most of the systems in place currently need to be upgraded and there are many missing electrical schematics this position could help to develop for troubleshooting purposes.
 
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Duties may include, but are not limited to the following:
  • Electrical System project management.
  • Electrical/Programming troubleshooting.
  • Electrical/Programming training of technicians.
  • Manage inventory of print library/archive and backups for all machines.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
  • Electrical System knowledge and experience to include VFD(s), Servos, high and low voltage troubleshooting.
  • Ability and experience troubleshooting and modifying Electrical/PLC-GUI Programming/Controls
  • Ability to use laptop to troubleshoot a PLC problem.
  • Ability to use laptop to point a Maintenance Technician to a machine problem.
  • Ability to troubleshoot scale, x-ray, and checkweigher problems.
  • Ability to resolve VFD, Servo, safety module or miscellaneous drive faults.
  • Ability to make PLC program modifications and tuning adjustments (timers, fault capture)
  • Possess a basic understanding of PID loops.
  • AutoCAD electrical schematic one-line drawing development preferred but not required.
  • AutoCAD mechanical drawing development preferred but not required.
  • NFPA 70E Arc Flash safety certification is a plus.
  • Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to read and write in English.
                                                
Sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position. It is the candidate’s responsibility to ensure they are legally authorized to work in the location to which they apply.

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented CNC Machinist to set up and operate CNC machinery used in the manufacturing of precision components for the aerospace and aviation industry.
The CNC Machinist will be responsible for producing components according to engineering specifications, maintaining tight tolerances, inspecting finished parts, and ensuring all work meets established quality and safety standards.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Set up and operate CNC mills, lathes, and other machining equipment.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, work instructions, and operation sheets.
  • Machine precision metal components according to dimensional and material specifications.
  • Install and align cutting tools, fixtures, attachments, and workpieces.
  • Perform machine setups, tool changes, offsets, and adjustments.
  • Adjust machine feeds, speeds, and controls as required.
  • Read and understand CNC machine code, including G-code.
  • Measure completed and in-process components using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other precision measuring instruments.
  • Verify finished parts meet required tolerances and specifications.
  • Monitor machine operations for excessive vibration, worn tooling, dimensional variations, or equipment malfunctions.
  • Replace worn or damaged cutting tools when necessary.
  • Troubleshoot machining or production problems and make appropriate machine adjustments.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve machining processes and CNC programs.
  • Maintain accurate production, inspection, and quality documentation.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe machine shop environment.
  • Follow established safety procedures and applicable aerospace quality requirements.
  • Perform additional machine shop duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of CNC machining or related machine shop experience preferred.
  • Experience operating CNC mills and/or CNC lathes.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and dimensional specifications.
  • Knowledge of machining techniques, tooling applications, machine setups, feeds, speeds, and materials.
  • Ability to read and understand CNC programming code, including G-code.
  • Strong understanding of basic shop mathematics.
  • Experience using precision measuring instruments, including calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Ability to perform machine setups and troubleshoot machining problems.
  • Basic computer proficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and commitment to producing high-quality precision components.

Preferred Experience
  • Previous experience in aerospace or aviation manufacturing.
  • Experience machining aluminum, stainless steel, and other aerospace-grade materials.
  • CNC setup and programming experience.
  • Familiarity with CAD/CAM manufacturing environments.
  • Experience working within AS9100, FAA, ISO, or other regulated aerospace quality environments.

Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, and use of hands and arms.
  • Ability to lift and/or move approximately 40 pounds when required.
  • Ability to safely move materials using appropriate lifting equipment when necessary.

job.title: Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance  to work at a company located in the Claremore, OK area!

 
Job Title: Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance 
 
Job Location: Claremore, Ok
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $25-$45 DOE 90 Day full benefits
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
 
 
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED -  Daily Duties & Responsibilities
  • Pre-Trip Inspections: Check truck fluids, tires, brakes, vacuum pumps, and secure all hoses and valves. 
  • Site Preparation: Locate underground tanks, dig to expose access lids using tools like a rock bar or soil probe, and manage physical labor on site. 
  • Waste Extraction: Hook up suction hoses, operate vacuum pump systems, and carefully monitor waste flow to prevent spills. 
  • Transportation & Disposal: Drive loaded tanker waste securely to an approved municipal or regional treatment facility. 
  • Customer Service: Answer client questions regarding the pumping process and note any structural damage or failing components inside the septic system. 
Equipment Maintenance Checklist
  • Daily Checks: Inspect suction hoses for cracks, soft spots, or loose clamps; test valves for smooth operation.
  • Weekly Tasks: Clear debris from tank baffles, clean sludge buildup, and inspect the primary shut-off float and manway gaskets.
  • Monthly & Routine Servicing: Check fluid levels, grease PTO shafts, inspect vacuum pump performance, and test vehicle battery terminals for corrosion.
 
Requirements
  • Reasonable Driving Background: CDL Preferred, not required. 
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy items (frequently over 50 to 150 lbs) and work outdoors in varied weather conditions.
  • Safety & Compliance: Strict adherence to Department of Transportation (DOT) and environmental waste disposal guidelines. 
 
 
90 days will move to permanent employee, and become eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401k program.
 
Position will be paid overtime past base hours and can be considered on call.

job.description:

Job Title: Sanitation Technician
 
Job Location: Rogers, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:   $18 per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Basic Functions 
 
The Sanitation Technician performs functions that combine traditional custodial services with equipment specific cleaning. Includes functional cleaning/sanitizing for areas and equipment within the facility as well as projects involving the building and ground. 
 
Main Duties 
 
  1. Performs cleaning of equipment services using appropriate procedures and inspections and ensures guards removed are replaced after servicing. 
  2. Performs all needed sanitary requirements of equipment, outside grounds, restroom facilities, and of trash compacting and interior overheads and exhaust vents. 
  3. Accounts for all labor, operational supplies in an accurate and timely fashion; initiates and completes all necessary documents and work schedules for State and Local regulatory requirements. 
  4. Sweeps, wipes, scrubs, vacuums, sanitizes, washes, and picks up as required to keep building, grounds, and equipment clean, ensuring a clean environment to produce. 
  5. Properly wear personal protective equipment as required and provided by the company. Wear appropriate uniform/clothing and follow all GMP's/company standards. 
  6. Ensure safe and proper use of tools and equipment; ensure hand tools are free of defects; maintain neat and orderly work area and ensure proper storage/disposal of solvents, paints, and other cleaning chemicals in accordance with OSHA, EPA and other regulatory agencies.
  7. Maintain current knowledge of cleaning methods and procedures. 
  8. Communicate/coordinate with other department to ensure optimum, efficient utilization of nonrunning time to properly sanitize production lines. 
  9. Perform other duties as assigned, including assisting other members of the bakery team where needed (breakdowns and emergencies). 
  10. Take appropriate action to ensure the integrity and sustained certification of the SQF system. 
  11. Responsible for reporting and taking any necessary action to prevent food safety and food quality problems from occurring. 
  12. Responsible for following and enforcing procedures outlined in the Food Safety Plan and the Food Quality Plan and any of SQF system and other 3rd party audits. 
 
Requirements 
 
  1. Knowledge of basic math skills. 
  2. Ability to comprehend label instructions, SDS and other safety warnings and chemical mixing formulations. 
  3. Knowledge of basic sanitation principles in a food processing facility, including knowledge of FDA, USDA, and EPA is preferred. 
  4. Must be able to work various hours, including night shifts
  5. Must have the ability to routinely and frequently stand, stoop, bend, climb and lift to meet bakery cleaning requirements. 
  6. Must have good hand-eye coordination and possess motor skills enabling mobility and quick reflexes, as well as dexterity. 
  7. Must have visual/hearing ability sufficient to recognize or detect warning devices/signs. 
  8. Must have ability to routinely lift up to 50lbs. 
 
Food Safety Responsibilities 
 
Follow all GMP’s, Practice and comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and other work rules; includes compliance such as lockout/tagout, electrical safety, confined space.

job.description:

Job Title: CNC Machinist/Operator
 
Job Location: Jonesboro, AR/Paragould, AR

  1. $20-$23 p/hr
  2. Monday-Friday 
 
Requirements:
  1. Education: High school diploma or GED; technical or vocational training in metal fabrication is a plus.
  2. Experience: 1 to 3+ years working in an industrial manufacturing or metal fabrication environment operating CNC machinery.
  3. Technical Skills: Ability to read and interpret blueprints, proficiently use micrometer, proficiently use calipers, interpret and read shop drawings, and geometric tolerances.
  4. Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for long shifts and frequently lift or move materials weighing 35 to 50 pounds.
  5. Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, basic shop math skills, and the ability to work independently or in a team
 
Job Description:
A CNC Machinist sets up, programs, and operates computer-controlled machinery to cut, shape, and finish precision metal and plastic parts.
  1. Read Blueprints: Interpret technical drawings, schematics, and CAD/CAM files to understand exact part dimensions.
  2. Setup and Program: Install cutting tools, secure raw materials, and input programs to guide machine operations.
  3. Monitor and Inspect: Oversee production runs and use precision measuring tools like calipers to check that finished parts match specifications.
  4. Troubleshoot: Fix minor machine errors, adjust speeds and feeds, and perform routine equipment maintenance.
  5. Operator: Focuses on loading parts, running cycles, and basic quality checks.
  6. Machinist: Handles more complex programming, advanced machine setup, and troubleshooting.

job.title: Maintenance Technician (3rd Shift) - Melrose Park, IL
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for 2nd and 3rd Shift Maintenance Technicians to work at a company located in the Melrose Park, IL area!


Job Title





Maintenance Technician - 2nd and 3rd Shift
 
Position Location




Melrose Park, IL
 
Pay/hours for position





 
Pay: $30.00-$35.00 per hour depending on experience 


 
Requirements of position




 
 
Qualifications:
  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or degree is a plus.
  • 2-5 years of experience in an industrial bakery and/or food manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Strong mechanical and troubleshooting skills with a service-oriented mindset. 
  • Candidates must have strong PLC experience and advanced electrical and experience working with automated equipment.
  • Experience with equipment maintenance, including conveyors, pneumatic systems, and hydraulics. Power Industrial Training Certification is a plus. Strong proficiency in electrical systems and PLC diagnostics 
  • Welding experience (MIG, TIG, Stick) is a significant advantage. Must be a self-starter capable of working independently and completing projects without supervision. Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Physical ability to stand for extended periods, walk, lift up to 60 pounds frequently, climb, pull, push, carry, grasp, reach, twist, turn, and stoop as needed.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including overtime, weekends, and holidays, as required by the production schedule.
  • Must be process-oriented, methodical, and committed to maintaining a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are preferred.
 
 
 
 
 
Responsibilities of position





 
About the Role
 
The Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of machinery and mechanical equipment in the production facility. This role focuses on minimizing downtime, maintaining quality standards, and supporting the production team by performing timely repairs, adjustments, and preventive maintenance.

Key Skills: Mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, PLC diagnostics, and welding capabilities. 

 Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform setup, repair, and maintenance of production machinery, including ovens, packing lines, and conveyors, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.
  • Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance to identify potential issues before they impact production.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems to resolve equipment malfunctions quickly and effectively.
  • Repair and maintain plumbing systems, hydraulic components, and cutting tools to support facility operations.
  • Operate and maintain power tools and industrial equipment safely, adhering to all safety protocols.
  • Perform welding tasks (MIG, TIG, Stick) to repair or fabricate machine components as needed.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) systems and electrical issues to maintain automation systems.
  • Document maintenance activities, including repairs and inspections, ensuring accurate records for compliance and future reference.
  • Collaborate with the production team to minimize disruptions and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support changeovers by preparing and adjusting equipment to meet production requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices), safety protocols, and food industry regulations.  
 
Benefits:
  • Healthcare coverage including medical, dental and vision\
  • 401k Plan
  • Short-term disability available
  • Paid holidays, vacation and paid sick leave

job.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Quality Assurance to work at a company located in the Miramar, FL area!

Job Title: Quality Assurance
 
Job Location: Miramar
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $18 - $19 p/hr
 
Posicion: (Quality Assurance Specialist – QA Specialist)
Salario: $18.00–$19.00 por hora, según la experiencia
Tipo de empleo: Tiempo completo
 
Resumen del puesto
Estamos buscando un Quality Assurance responsable, organizado y orientado a los detalles para apoyar los procesos de calidad y garantizar que los productos cumplan con los estándares establecidos, los procedimientos internos y los requisitos regulatorios aplicables.
El candidato ideal debe tener experiencia en aseguramiento de la calidad dentro de un entorno de manufactura, producción de alimentos, suplementos nutricionales o industria farmacéutica. Se requiere atención al detalle, habilidades de documentación y capacidad para identificar y reportar problemas de calidad.
 
Responsabilidades principales
  • Realizar inspecciones rutinarias de aseguramiento de la calidad durante los procesos de manufactura y producción.
  • Verificar que los productos cumplan con los estándares y las especificaciones de calidad establecidos.
  • Revisar registros de producción, documentación de lotes, etiquetas y empaques para garantizar su exactitud y cumplimiento.
  • Verificar que se cumplan las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP) y los procedimientos internos de calidad.
  • Supervisar las condiciones de limpieza, saneamiento y cumplimiento de los procedimientos establecidos en las áreas de producción.
  • Identificar, documentar y reportar problemas de calidad, desviaciones e incumplimientos.
  • Colaborar en investigaciones de calidad y en la implementación de acciones correctivas y preventivas (CAPA).
  • Mantener registros de calidad, informes de inspección y documentación actualizados y precisos.
  • Apoyar auditorías internas y otras actividades relacionadas con la calidad.
  • Comunicar oportunamente cualquier problema de calidad a los supervisores y al equipo gerencial.
 
Requisitos y cualificaciones
  • Se prefiere experiencia previa en Aseguramiento de la Calidad (QA) en manufactura, producción de alimentos, suplementos nutricionales o industria farmacéutica.
  • Conocimiento de las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP) y los procedimientos de documentación de calidad.
  • Excelente atención al detalle y habilidades organizativas.
  • Capacidad para leer, comprender y seguir procedimientos e instrucciones de trabajo.
  • Conocimientos básicos de computación, entrada de datos y mantenimiento de registros.
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en un ambiente de producción dinámico.
  • Diploma de escuela secundaria (High School Diploma) o equivalente, preferiblemente.
 
Habilidades preferidas:
Experiencia en pruebas de control de calidad, microbiología o técnicas de laboratorio analítico.
Conocimiento de CAPA (Acciones Correctivas y Preventivas), análisis de causa raíz y procesos de mejora de la calidad.

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Aviation Quality Control Inspector to work at a company located in the Sunrise, FL area!

Job Title: Aviation Quality Control Inspector
 
Job Location: Sunrise, FL 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:$30 - $40/HR  BASED ON EXPERIENCE
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
 
Pay Rate: $30 - $40/HR  BASED ON EXPERIENCE
Location: Sunrise, FL
Shift: M-F 6am-2:30pm
 
The Quality Control Inspector- Ensures aviation articles meet manufacturer and operator specifications, including Dimensions, condition, operational limits, and compliance with the company’s Quality Management System. This role is critical in maintaining adherence to quality procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory standards set by federal and other governing agencies.
 
 Essential Job Functions:
  • Conduct thorough inspections using various methods to assess product airworthiness.
  • Interpret engineering publications, shop travelers, FAA regulations, and manufacturer technical data and drawings to define inspection scope.
  • Determine optimal inspection techniques and sequence of operations.
  • Use precision measuring instruments to verify part dimensions, tolerances, and clearances.
  • Review trace documentation to identify potential unapproved parts.
  • Accurately interpret technical data, blueprints, and engineering drawings.
  • Identify discrepancies in aircraft components and systems.
  • Maintain clear, accurate records of maintenance and inspections.
  • Audit maintenance documentation for completeness and accuracy prior to return-to-service approval.
  • Perform in-process inspections during maintenance activities.
  • Document discrepancies using company forms and communicate findings to technicians and department leads.
  • Enter inspection results and maintenance data into electronic systems.
  • Verify article configuration and functionality using appropriate technical references.
  • Communicate inspection outcomes effectively in both verbal and written formats.
  • Support other inspectors and technicians through mentoring and guidance.
  • Collaborate with management and planning teams to prioritize tasks.
  • Monitor compliance with 14 CFR Part 145, Part 21 and the FAA-approved Repair Station/Quality Control Manual.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Quality Control Manager or Chief Inspector.
 
 Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Valid and current FAA Airframe & Powerplant or Powerplant certification.
  • Minimum 18 months of hands-on experience with inspection techniques.
  • At least 5 years of experience in a Repair Station or aviation maintenance facility.
  • Strong understanding of airworthiness standards and return-to-service procedures.
  • Background in aircraft emergency equipment maintenance or inspection is an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Strong task prioritization and time management.
  • Proficiency in basic shop math.
  • Foundational knowledge of aviation sciences (e.g., aerodynamics, hydraulics, electrical and pneumatic systems).
  • Basic computer literacy.
  • Skilled in using calibrated measuring tools and general hand tools.
  • Capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with engineering concepts is desirable.

job.title: 2026 Road Construction Flaggerr
job.description:
------------------------------
ENGLISH
------------------------------

JOB TITLE: Road Construction Flagger
LOCATION: MI (Statewide)
Additional locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Jackson, Lansing, Mount Pleasant, Kalamazoo
PAY: $20.00/hr ($20-$27 Depending on travel)
SCHEDULE: Mon–Sun, 6am–11:55pm
Background Check Required: Yes

The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Road Construction Flagger to work at companies located throughout MI!

Hourly rate is based on the one-way distance from your home office to the assigned job site, calculated using the shortest available route in Google Maps.

0–49 miles: $20.00/hour
50–79 miles: $21.00/hour
80–99 miles: $22.00/hour
100+ miles: $27.00/hour

Statewide Hiring Locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Jackson, Mount Pleasant

RESPONSIBILITIES:
As a flagger, you’re an important part of keeping both workers and drivers safe. 
Your responsibilities include:
• Controlling traffic through construction zones
• Guiding drivers safely around work areas
• Using signs, paddles, radios, and hand signals
• Communicating with your team to keep traffic flowing smoothly.

PPE Provided by JobSquad:
• Safety vest (MDOT Class 3)
• Safety glasses (clear & tinted)
• Hard hat
• Sign & Poles
• Headlamp
• 2-way radio (you provide batteries)
• Poncho

You’ll need to bring:
• T-shirt or long-sleeved shirt (no tank tops)
• Steel-toed leather boots (ankle coverage required)
• Durable jeans or work pants (no shorts or sweatpants)

REQUIREMENTS:
• Valid driver’s license
• Reliable personal vehicle (must remain on-site during your shift)
• Proof of auto insurance (in your name/listed as an insured driver)
• Availability for full days (sunrise to sunset), including weekends.
• Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
• No OWI/DUI within the past 5 years
• Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
• Willingness to travel up to 100+ miles one way.

SKILLS & ABILITIES:
What the Job Looks Like
• Schedules are shared daily through our dispatch app (Assignar), by 7:00 PM each night.
• Shifts typically range from 4 to 14 hours, depending on weather and project needs. (Not including travel time)
• Work sites change daily. Statewide travel is required.
• Overtime opportunities are available.
• Because of the nature of roadwork, scheduled breaks aren’t always guaranteed—but we do our best to make sure you get rest when site conditions allow.

CERTIFICATIONS:
• Drivers License, Auto Insurance

The JobSquad Solutions Team is made up of experts around the country. Serving our local workforce communities is our passion.

------------------------------
ESPAÑOL
------------------------------

PUESTO: Señalizador de Construcción de Carreteras
UBICACIÓN: MI (En todo el estado)
Ubicaciones adicionales: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Jackson, Lansing, Mount Pleasant, Kalamazoo
PAGO: $20.00/hr ($20-$27 Depending on travel)
HORARIO: Mon–Sun, 6am–11:55pm
Verificación de Antecedentes Requerida: Sí

El equipo de JobSquad Solutions está buscando un(a) Señalizador de Construcción de Carreteras para trabajar en empresas ubicadas en todo MI.

La tarifa horaria se basa en la distancia de ida desde tu oficina central hasta el lugar de trabajo asignado, calculada usando la ruta más corta disponible en Google Maps.

0–49 millas: 20,00 $/hora
50–79 millas: 21,00 $/hora
80–99 millas: 22,00 $/hora
100+ millas: 27,00 $/hora

Lugares de contratación a nivel estatal: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Jackson, Mount Pleasant

RESPONSABILIDADES:
Como señalista, eres una parte importante para mantener la seguridad tanto de los trabajadores como de los conductores. 
Tus responsabilidades incluyen:
• Control del tráfico en zonas de construcción
• Guiando a los conductores de forma segura por zonas de trabajo
• Uso de carteles, palas, radios y señales manuales
• Comunicarte con tu equipo para que el tráfico fluya sin problemas.

PPE proporcionado por JobSquad:
• Chaleco de seguridad (MDOT Clase 3)
• Gafas de seguridad (transparentes y tintadas)
• Casco
• Signos y postes
• Faro
• Radio bidirecional (tú proporcionas las baterías)
• Poncho

You tendrás que traer:
• Camiseta o camisa de manga larga (sin camisetas de tirantes)
• Botas de cuero con punta de acero (se requiere cobertura de tobillo)
• Vaqueros resistentes o pantalones de trabajo (sin pantalones cortos ni chándal)

REQUISITOS:
• Permiso de conducir válido
• Vehículo personal fiable (debe permanecer en el lugar durante el turno)
• Prueba de seguro de coche (a tu nombre/registrada como conductor asegurado)
• Disponibilidad para días completos (de amanecer a atardecer), incluyendo fines de semana.
• Capacidad para trabajar al aire libre en cualquier condición meteorológica.
• No ha habido OWI/DUI en los últimos 5 años
• Capacidad para superar una verificación de antecedentes y un control de drogas.
• Disposición para viajar hasta 100+ millas de ida.

HABILIDADES:
Cual es el trabajo
• Los horarios se comparten diariamente a través de nuestra aplicación de despacho (Assignar), a las 19:00 horas cada noche.
• Los turnos suelen variar entre 4 y 14 horas, dependiendo del clima y las necesidades del proyecto. (Sin contar el tiempo de viaje)
• Los lugares de trabajo cambian diariamente. Se requiere viajar por todo el estado.
• Hay oportunidades de horas extra.
• Debido a la naturaleza de las obras en la carretera, las pausas programadas no siempre están garantizadas, pero hacemos todo lo posible para que descanses cuando las condiciones del lugar lo permiten.

CERTIFICACIONES:
• Drivers License, Auto Insurance

El equipo de JobSquad Solutions está formado por expertos de todo el país. Servir a nuestras comunidades laborales locales es nuestra pasión.

#ADV123456
