80–99 miles: $22.00/hour
100+ miles: $27.00/hour

Statewide Hiring Locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing & Jackson

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• As a flagger, you’re an important part of keeping both workers and drivers safe. Your responsibilities include:
• Controlling traffic through construction zones
• Guiding drivers safely around work areas
• Using signs, paddles, radios, and hand signals
• Communicating with your team to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
PPE Provided by JobSquad:
• Safety vest (MDOT Class 3)
• Safety glasses (clear & tinted)
• Hard hat
• Sign & Poles
• Headlamp
• 2-way radio (you provide batteries)
• Poncho
You’ll need to bring:
• T-shirt or long-sleeved shirt (no tank tops)
• Steel-toed leather boots (ankle coverage required)
• Durable jeans or work pants (no shorts or sweatpants)

REQUIREMENTS:
• Valid driver’s license
• Reliable personal vehicle (must remain on-site during your shift)
• Proof of auto insurance (in your name/listed as an insured driver)
• Availability for full days (sunrise to sunset), including weekends.
• Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
• No OWI/DUI within the past 5 years
• Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
• Willingness to travel up to 100+ miles one way.

SKILLS & ABILITIES:
What the Job Looks Like
• Schedules are shared daily through our dispatch app (Assignar), by 7:00 PM each night.
• Shifts typically range from 4 to 14 hours, depending on weather and project needs. (Not including travel time)
• Work sites change daily. Statewide travel is required.
• Overtime opportunities are available.
• Because of the nature of roadwork, scheduled breaks aren’t always guaranteed—but we do our best to make sure you get rest when site conditions allow.
Apply Now! Text "FLAG" to 269-279-7222 to get started.

BENEFITS:
Ready to get to work?
We're hiring dependable team members who are looking for stable employment and growth opportunities.
Do you know someone looking for work?
Friends Don't Keep Secrets! Refer your friends and earn a $100 bonus for every successful referral. There's no limit to how many referrals you can make!
At JobSquad, We Have You COVERED
We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, giving you the coverage and peace of mind you deserve.
JobSquad is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

CERTIFICATIONS:
• Drivers License, Auto Insurance, Drug Screen, Transportation, Traffic Control, Flagger, Attention to Detail, Safety Awareness, Reliability, Following Directions, Problem Solving, Work Zone Safety, Traffic Management, Safety Compliance, Radio Communication, Construction Labor, Outdoor Work, Time Management, Customer Service

job.title: 2026 First Shift Working Lead
job.description:
------------------------------
ENGLISH
------------------------------

JOB TITLE: Working Leads
LOCATION: Pittston, PA
PAY: $20.00/hr
SCHEDULE: Day Shift: Mon–Thu, 7am–5:30pm; Night Shift: Tue–Fri, 7pm–5:30am; Weekend Shift: Fri–Sun, 6am–6:30pm
Background Check Required: Yes

The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Working Leads to work at a company located in the Pittston, PA area!

Looking for working leads and back up leads for all shifts. Day Shift Monday-Thursday 7am-5:30pm, Night Shift Tuesday-Friday from 7pm-5:30am and Weekend Shift Friday-Sunday from 6am-6:30pm. Pay Rate is $20 for back up lead and $21.00 for lead

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and dependable Yard Mule Operator to join our logistics team in the Sweetwater, FL area. job.description:
------------------------------
ENGLISH

JOB TITLE: Production Supervisor
LOCATION: Louisville, KY
PAY: $23.00/hr ($23/hr minimum, DOE)
Background Check Required: Yes

The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Production Supervisor to work at a company located in the Louisville, KY area!

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Lead safety, quality, productivity, and improvement initiatives on designated shift
• Ensure adherence of employees to plant safety rules and that health and safety regulations are obeyed on shift.
• Responsible for delivery of the production plan to quality, efficiency, and required date.
• Line set up per assembly drawing to maximize efficiency.
• Capable of making changes to line setup to increase efficiency.
• Management of Area Coordinators and Leads regarding safety, quality findings, and daily production needs.
• Managing and entry of daily labor and production results.
• Resolve problems that would adversely affect the performance of the Area Coordinators and the continuity of the team concept.
• Ensure the safe use and operation of equipment and the training/documentation of qualified employees.
• Review all production paperwork for accuracy and compliance.
• Understand and coach on build/assembly specs.
• Root cause analysis for quality, safety, or productivity failures
• Maintain agility, flexibility, and a willingness to modify one’s approach to achieve desired results; respond quickly to changing demands, processes, and updated information.
• Plan, assign, and direct work for all hourly production employees; appraise performance and provide feedback as needed; assist in resolving complaints; hold employees accountable as needed; communicate issues and results daily.
• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor or manager.

REQUIREMENTS:
• Experience with continuous improvement and Lean Methodology is a plus.
• Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
• Packing solutions industry experience preferred.
• Regular attendance and punctuality required
• Must be able to work in high temperature & humidity conditions while wearing proper PPE including, but not limited to, hearing protection, steel toe shoes, and safety glasses.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Must be able to lift 50 lbs.
• Willing and able to work up to 12-hour shifts.
• Knowledge in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word)
• Bilingual English/Spanish required.

SKILLS & ABILITIES:
• Safety and security – Observe safety and security procedures; Report unsafe conditions; Use equipment and materials properly.
• Attendance/Punctuality – Is consistently at work and on time.
• Leadership – Establishes high morale throughout staff by showing fairness, consistency, and support of employees.
• Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems promptly.
• Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively; Participates in meetings.
• Written Communication – Writes clearly; Able to read and interpret written information.
• Teamwork – Contributes to building positive team spirit.
• Training and Mentoring – Effectively trains and mentors employees on the proper setup, operation, and maintenance of equipment.
• Diversity – Promotes a harassment-free environment.
• Ethics – Treats people with integrity and ethics.
• Organizational Support – Supports the organization’s goals, values, and code of ethics.
• Judgment – Exhibit sound and accurate judgment; Includes appropriate people in the decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
• Planning/Organizing – Prioritizes work activities; Uses time efficiently.
• Professionalism – Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Treats others with respect and consideration; Accepts responsibility for own actions.
